name: Beautiful.ai
summary: Presentation software with auto-formatting slides, AI generation and brand controls for teams.
description: Beautiful.ai creates presentations with smart slide templates that adjust layout automatically, AI-generated decks and brand controls that keep company slides consistent. It includes data visualisation, integrations and analytics. A 14-day free trial of Pro or Team is offered; Pro costs $14.50 per month for individuals billed annually. Free plans exist for students. It targets enterprise teams that need consistent slides across the company.

howToUse.title: Open Beautiful.ai
howToUse.description: Go to Beautiful.ai and choose Try it free or Get started to create presentations. A 14-day trial of Pro or Team is offered.

howToUse.title: Build the deck
howToUse.description: Choose templates built as smart slides so the layout can adjust automatically, or generate a deck with the AI presentation workflow.

howToUse.title: Apply brand controls
howToUse.description: Turn on brand controls so company slides stay consistent, and add data visualisation, integrations and analytics. An individual on Pro pays $14.50 per month when billed annually. Students have free plans. Enterprise teams are the audience.
